chapter: Second lining and the brass bands
title: Ringing the bell, old musicians and Buddy Bolin
summary: White says he still rings the bell and meets old musicians; Allen asks about Buddy Bolin, whose death followed the killing of Chief Anderson, and the old workhouse site.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Well, why don't you talk about those times, the old times. Well, that's what I'm talking about.

The church and everything. That's what he wants to know. Well, I don't talk about all them new, all them old times. I don't talk about all that. All them music parts. I know all that. Music, all them music parts. I know all that.
Tell them how you ring the bell and everything.

Well, I used to, as far as that, I used to do that yet. I ring the bell yet. Fuel them. I make parades once in a while, but I'll be careful how I go around with them, you see? Like if I meet, I meet with Kid Alley. Or Kid Punch. Or Happy. Or anyone of them musicians. Old musicians. I know a baby. I say, what you say? Rickar says, oh, you all come hard. I say, yeah, you all come Rickar. I say, anything, huh? I say, anything up? I say, yeah, man. We got one over the river. I say, yeah. Wait on what street? Tell them, I'm gone. Be right over there. Ain't no place. I don't know where. Ain't no musicians you can't call. I don't know.
Did you ever go around to the Globe's home? Yeah. Do you remember a guy that used to play that called Buddy Bolin? Yeah, I know him.

How long has he been gone? Oh, Buddy Bolin been gone a long time. Buddy Bolin been dead a long time. You remember when he, you remember, Buddy Bolin was, Buddy Bolin died when, you remember when they killed Keith Anderson? Yeah, I've heard about that. Well, all right. He died right after he killed Keith Anderson. You remember when Chief Anderson got killed? Yeah, I remember when Chief Anderson got killed. Oh, man. You see Orlean Street? Mm-hmm. Orlean Street, that used to be, that used to be a parish. On Orlean Street, that used to be a parish. By the square? Yeah, that used to be a parish. Before they had the, before they had that tower there, that used to be a parish. The old workhouse used to be there. After they moved from there, then they moved, they built that new place on Tulane and Broad. And I know plenty. I know all of them. They know, they nothing. I don't know what, and this, and...
